rules: Use dark colors independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Tint neutral greys with a bit of blue to make them feel alive (cyberpunk feel).
NO Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for Headings.
NO Space Grotesk for dashboard sections.
Headings (Rajdhani) must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Data, prices, and stats must use IBM Plex Mono for a technical readout look.
Use variable weights to break standard Regular/Bold binaries.

surfaces: Glassmorphism (The Crystal Variant): backdrop-blur-xl with bg-black/60.
MUST have 1px delicate inner stroke for borders (e.g., border-cyan-500/30 or border-white/10).
Avoid muddy gray transparency. High-end glass increases color saturation.
Grid Borders (The Technical Look) for data-heavy sections (history grid). Expose the skeleton.
neon_effects: Add glowing shadows to primary buttons and active neon borders.
Use subtle drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,240,255,0.5)] on text for cyber neon feel.
japanese_accents: Incorporate decorative Japanese Kanji subtly in the background (e.g., 'スキャン' for Scan, 'システム' for System, '東京' for Tokyo) with very low opacity (text-white/5).
Use vertical text layouts for aesthetic sidebars or decorative elements to emphasize the Tokyo cyberpunk vibe.

layouts_and_grids.general: Mobile-first, asymmetrical for marketing/auth areas, dense 'High Density Grid' for history/dashboard.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy (p-6, p-8, p-12). Containers with borders must have internal padding.
layouts_and_grids.bento_grid: For history: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized.

auth_page: Split layout: 50% image (Tokyo night street), 50% form.
Image overlay: bg-black/40 with slight grain texture. Max overlay opacity.
Form: Glassmorphism container, neon glowing login/register tabs, Google login button with cyber styling.
upload_zone: Large central area, dashed glowing border (border-cyan-500/50).
Include a pulsing or scanning animation (e.g., moving horizontal cyan line like a scanner).
Empty state background: abstract cyberpunk pattern.
ai_result_card: MUST have inline editable fields for name, category, price estimate, description, confidence.
Technical readout aesthetic for the confidence bar.
Cardless or flat background with 1px border. Technical data layout.
offers_section: Shop buttons (Amazon, LDLC, Google Shopping) should use sharp technical buttons with interaction animations.
footer: MUST include EXACT text: 'fait par theo pour le bac 2026-2027'.
Center-aligned or technical layout for footer.

motion: Hover states: Neon glow increase, slight lift (-translate-y-1).
Entrance animations: Staggered fade-up for history grid items (framer-motion).
Scanning effect: Vertical scanning line loop over the uploaded image.
Required: Hover, click/press, and focus states for accessibility.
accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios are met despite dark themes. (Normal text 4.5:1, large 3:1)
Focus states must have high contrast (focus:ring-cyan-500).
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the scanning animations.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, etc).

image_urls.description: Tokyo night neon street for the auth page split layout.
Cyberpunk abstract tech for upload zone or decorative background.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Install and import Google Fonts in index.css: Rajdhani, Zen Dots, Outfit, IBM Plex Mono.
Update tailwind.config.js to include new colors and fonts based on this design system.
DO NOT break existing functionality. This is a redesign request only.
Use framer-motion for animations and lucide-react for icons.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Create new components in src/components/ui/ matching the existing Shadcn conventions.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers, overlays, or any surface with content underneath.
